editing_instructions: Edit message_body when DemoBoutique wants different wording.
If a {{number}} placeholder is added, removed, or repurposed, update variables in the same template.
Keep utility templates factual and tied to a customer request or transaction.
Do not use marketing content in UTILITY templates.
Submit only the templates needed for the first live workflow.

templates.name: assistant_unavailable
templates.purpose: Safe fallback when AI generation fails but the conversation should not go silent.
templates.message_body: Hi {{1}}, Avni is temporarily unavailable. The DemoBoutique team will follow up shortly.

variables.meaning: customer first name or friendly fallback

owner_questions: Should this say Avni, DemoBoutique assistant, or only DemoBoutique team?
Should the follow-up promise say shortly, today, or a specific business-hours window?
templates.submission_notes: Good first utility template because it protects the demo and early live use from silent failure.

templates.name: handoff_followup
templates.purpose: Owner follow-up after Avni routes an issue to human review.
templates.message_body: Hi {{1}}, we checked your request about {{2}}. The DemoBoutique team will help you from here.

variables.meaning: customer first name or friendly fallback

owner_questions: Should this be more formal or more conversational?
Should it mention that Avni handed the chat to the owner?
templates.submission_notes: Useful once Control Room handoff notes are part of the owner workflow.

templates.name: order_detail_request
templates.purpose: Ask for order details before discussing returns, exchanges, damaged items, or delivery.
templates.message_body: Hi {{1}}, please share your order ID and a photo if relevant so the DemoBoutique team can check this properly.

variables.meaning: customer first name or friendly fallback

owner_questions: Should every return or damage case require a photo?
Should the owner ask for invoice number, order ID, phone number, or all three?
templates.submission_notes: Keeps policy-sensitive cases factual before the owner confirms return/exchange rules.

templates.name: delivery_status_update
templates.purpose: Owner-confirmed delivery update after order lookup.
templates.message_body: Hi {{1}}, your DemoBoutique order {{2}} is currently {{3}}. We will update you if anything changes.

variables.meaning: customer first name or friendly fallback

owner_questions: What exact order identifier does DemoBoutique use?
Should delivery updates mention courier names or tracking links?
templates.submission_notes: Submit after the real order lookup and delivery-status process is known.

templates.name: promo_opt_in
templates.purpose: Ask for explicit consent before sending future promotional messages.
templates.message_body: Hi {{1}}, would you like to receive DemoBoutique updates for new arrivals and offers? Reply YES to opt in.

variables.meaning: customer first name or friendly fallback

owner_questions: Does DemoBoutique want promotional WhatsApp messages in phase 1?
What opt-out wording should be used after a customer opts in?
templates.submission_notes: Defer unless the owner explicitly wants marketing. This is not needed for the first support/demo workflow.
